primitives.contract: Apply a registered condition with typed duration and source.
Resolve d20 attack formula against AC with typed advantage state.
Resolve typed ability or cultivation check against contest/DC.
Start and maintain one concentration effect with typed end conditions.
Create or modify a deterministic typed area/zone.
Apply typed damage packet after resistance and prevention.
Reduce pending damage by a nonnegative bounded amount before commit.
Emit a registered deterministic combat event without creating encounter state.
Push or pull a target through legal geometry without opportunity attacks.
Gain a bounded integer resource up to maximum; emit resource_gained.
Ignite an unattended flammable object in the affected area.
Move an actor through legal geometry up to a typed distance.
Move the actor without provoking opportunity attacks for that movement.
Claim a source-scoped once-per-turn rider exactly once.
Register a reaction at an exact trigger checkpoint.
Apply typed resistance to a matching damage packet once.
Resolve typed ability saving throw against a fixed DC.
Spend a bounded integer resource only when current >= cost; emit resource_spent.
Suppress one enumerated penalty without ending the underlying effect.
